sample_tweets.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of Meta Law Enforcement Portal Credentials  A darkweb forum post reveals that an underground actor is allegedly offering access to Meta’s Law Enforcement Online Request System (LEORS). According to the listing, the seller claims to possess verified law enforcement agency (LEA) account credentials for the portal, which is used by authorities to submit data disclosure requests to Meta platforms including WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram.  The post alleges that buyers can use these credentials to submit Basic Subscriber Information (BSI) requests. The types of data reportedly accessible through the system include: * Name at registration * Email address * Telephone number * Date and time of registration  Additionally, the listing claims the accounts have "Emergency Request" capabilities, allowing for priority processing of urgent cases with responses purportedly delivered within minutes. The seller states that no logs are kept on their side and accepts payment in Monero (XMR) or USDC.  The threat actor behind the post has a history of distributing large volumes of stolen credentials on underground forums. Previous activity includes the sale of hundreds of thousands of lines of "Fresh Private HQ ULP LOGS" and exclusive combolists for platforms like Twitter. This pattern suggests a focus on bulk credential theft and the monetization of access to sensitive systems.  Meta Inc., one of the world's largest technology companies, operates critical infrastructure for billions of users globally. If authentic, the compromise of LEORS credentials could enable unauthorized surveillance of private communications and the exfiltration of user data under false pretenses of legal authority. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach of the LEORS portal has not been independently verified by Meta or security researchers.

sample_tweets.text: Be careful about those Scammers   🇰🇵 Researchers Built a Fake DeFi Startup, Then Hired Suspected North Korean IT Workers  Security researchers from ANY.RUN, BCA LTD and NorthScan created a convincing fake DeFi company and deliberately hired suspected **Famous Chollima** operatives to observe how North Korea’s IT-worker infiltration scheme functions after an employee gets inside a company.   * Researchers created **Ballena Azul / Blue Whale LTD**, complete with a website, branding, documentation and a plausible DeFi product. * Suspected DPRK operators were interviewed and subsequently given controlled virtual workstations hosted inside specially configured ANY.RUN sandbox environments. * Researchers could observe virtually every click, file operation and network connection made by the workers in real time. * The investigation documented the use of **forged identities, stolen SSNs, mule bank accounts, cryptocurrency wallets, proxy interviews and remote facilitators**. * One submitted driver's license contained metadata indicating it had been processed using **Google Gemini and contained a SynthID watermark**, helping researchers identify it as manipulated. * Another operator allegedly supplied what appeared to be an authentic photograph of someone else's New York driver's license. * Researchers also observed apparent use of **AI-assisted translation/interview tooling** during recruitment. * The investigation demonstrates that the objective extends beyond simply collecting salaries: once hired, an operative can receive legitimate, trusted access to **source code, internal systems, intellectual property and business processes**.   DPRK IT-worker operations blur the line between insider threat, identity fraud and state-sponsored intrusion. The attacker does not necessarily need to exploit a vulnerability when the organization itself provides credentials, endpoints and trusted access after a successful interview. Identity verification, employment KYC, device-location anomalies, bank-account validation and continuous insider-risk monitoring therefore become security controls, not merely HR processes.  Source: ANY.RUN / BCA LTD / NorthScan - any.run/cybersecurity-blog/l… #DDW #Intelligence #Lazarus #NorthKorea

🇵🇱 CERT Polska Reveals Novel Attack Path in Destructive Energy-Sector Cyberattack  CERT Polska has published a follow-up investigation into the coordinated cyberattacks that struck Poland’s energy sector on **29 December 2025**, revealing a previously undisclosed incident and what it says is a **real-world first involving a private APN as the attack vector**.   * The December campaign targeted **30 wind and solar installations**, a large combined heat and power (CHP) plant, and—newly disclosed—a **smaller CHP plant serving around 50,000 residents**.  * At the smaller CHP plant, attackers caused the **steam turbine and water-treatment system to shut down**, interrupting the cogeneration process. * Operators responded quickly enough that the outage was short-lived and **heat supplies to consumers were not disrupted**. * CERT Polska’s three-month investigation reconstructed the intrusion path and traced activity back to the device used by the attackers. * The key finding: attackers reached the OT environment through a **private APN**, exploiting a configuration that allowed arbitrary devices on that APN to communicate with one another.  * CERT Polska says this is, to its knowledge, the **first observed real-world cyberattack using a private APN to gain access to an OT network**. * Surveys conducted by CERT Polska found the same type of APN configuration was common among organizations in Poland and likely also used internationally.   **Analyst Note:** This is significant because private APNs are often treated as inherently trusted or isolated infrastructure. The incident shows that “private” does not automatically mean secure. Misconfigured east-west communication inside an APN can effectively turn telecom connectivity into a direct path toward operational technology.  Source: CERT Polska / NASK  cert.pl/en/posts/2026/08/inc… #DDW #Intelligence #OTSecurity #Poland

### 1. 현재 주요 사이버보안 트렌드
최근 사이버 위협은 AI 에이전트와 자동화 도구를 활용하여 공격의 효율성과 지속성을 극대화하는 방향으로 진화하고 있습니다. 특히 Microsoft Patch Tuesday를 통해 공개된 제로데이 취약점이 실제 공격에 즉각 악용되는 사례가 빈번하며, 공급망 공격 및 trojanized 소프트웨어를 통한 IT 전문가 타겟팅이 두드러집니다 ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/fresh-windows-zero-day-exploited-in-north-korean-cyberattacks/)). 또한, 랜섬웨어 조직은 블록체인 기술을 C2 인프라에 도입하여 추적과 차단을 회피하는 등 기술적 고도화를 꾀하고 있습니다 ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/deadlock-ransomware-uses-blockchain-to-resist-infrastructure-takedown/)).

### 2. 주요 위협 행위자 / 캠페인
*   **Lazarus Group**: 'Operation Dream Job' 캠페인을 통해 Windows 제로데이(CVE-2026-68820)를 악용, FudModule v3.1 rootkit을 배포 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208024))
*   **Sandworm**: IT 전문가를 대상으로 trojanized WireGuard VPN 클라이언트를 유포하여 타겟팅 ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/sandworm-hackers-target-it-pros-with-trojanized-wireguard-vpn-client/))
*   **Gunra Ransomware**: Fortinet 취약점을 악용하고 MFA를 우회하여 중요 인프라 타겟팅 ([DarkReading](https://www.darkreading.com/cyberattacks-data-breaches/gunra-ransomware-gang-fortinet-flaws-bypasses-mfa))
*   **Head Mare APT**: TrueConf 서버 취약점을 악용하여 PhantomCore 및 PhantomGraph 백도어 배포 ([Securelist](https://securelist.com/tr/head-mare-targets-trueconf-server-with-phantomcore/120988/))
*   **Kimwolf (Botnet)**: Android IoT 기기를 타겟으로 HTTP/2 DDoS 및 Ethereum ENS 기반 C2 통신 수행 ([Unit42](https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/kimwolf-v7-botnet-malware/))

### 3. 한국 관련 위협
*   **Lazarus Group의 국내 타겟팅**: 'Operation Dream Job' 캠페인이 국내 정부기관 및 방산 분야를 포함한 전 세계 방산 섹터를 타겟으로 함 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208024))
*   **다크웹 동향**: AhnLab ASEC에서 2026년 7월 다크웹 침해사고 및 위협 행위자 동향 보고서 발행 ([AhnLab ASEC](https://asec.ahnlab.com/ko/94916/))
*   **피싱 메일**: 상품 파손 및 세무 위반 사칭 스피어피싱 메일을 통한 악성코드 유포 지속 ([이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5773))

### 4. 주요 CVE / 취약점
*   **CVE-2026-58231**: SAP Commerce Cloud, CVSS 10.0, 원격 코드 실행 가능 ([TheHackerNews](https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/sap-commerce-cloud-flaw-could-let.html))
*   **CVE-2026-68820**: Windows AFD.sys, 권한 상승, **In-the-wild 악용 중** ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208024))
*   **CVE-2026-23918**: Apache HTTP Server, RCE 가능성 ([Twitter/zoomeye_team](https://twitter.com/zoomeye_team/status/2087465402297422112#m))
*   **CVE-2026-20349**: Cisco ASA/FTD, CVSS 8.6, DoS 악용 ([Twitter/FrontieraTechIT](https://twitter.com/FrontieraTechIT/status/2087462340446884128#m))
*   **CVE-2026-17106**: Docker, RCE 및 권한 상승 ([Twitter/Vulcanux_](https://twitter.com/Vulcanux_/status/2087465003829932135#m))

### 5. IOC 요약
*   **CVE**: CVE-2026-58231 ([TheHackerNews](https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/sap-commerce-cloud-flaw-could-let.html)), CVE-2026-68820 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208024))

### 6. 즉각 대응 권고
*   **Windows 보안 업데이트**: CVE-2026-68820이 포함된 8월 Microsoft 보안 업데이트를 즉시 적용하여 권한 상승 공격 차단.
